syntax_receipt.scope: Two SYCL translation-unit syntax checks only; no code generation, link, GPU, numerical, lifetime, allocation-fit, RESTORE, or speed proof.

candidate.provenance: Manifest states Main-authored MIT Strata source and no XeStrata project code/helpers/tests. Review inspected pinned candidate and primary-baseline source only; no XeStrata project source was used.

quality.budget: Both reports are within their assigned 1300-2100 word working budgets and 32 KiB hard limit.
quality.scope_and_depth: R971 traces the actual attention-piece/FFN-window path, state order, callbacks, placement fallback and owners. R972 separately counts route submissions, host maps, waits, gathers, dequantizations, GEMM jobs and placement cases. Their scopes are coherent and distinct.
quality.novelty_and_redundancy: Both reports add evidence that did not exist in R968-R970: a pinned engine integration and its source-level costs. They reuse earlier route-map and planner findings without repeating those analyses. Remaining adoption questions are implementation/measurement gates owned by Main.
quality.source_and_claim_quality: Source references and arithmetic are mostly accurate. Neither report presents syntax or arithmetic as GPU execution or a speed result. Corrections below narrow two cost statements and distinguish caller containment from an active cancellation bug.

findings.finding: Prefill is non-transactional: cancellation after one attention piece or during expert jobs can mutate recurrent/KV/PLE state without producing the paired callbacks. The current server caller prevents that partial session from becoming a reusable live prefix. It sets live_ok=false before reading, only re-enables it after a non-cancelled request, and skips live.swap(consumed) on cancellation (candidate src/program/generate.cpp:5963,6476-6482). The parking helper also refuses to snapshot when live_ok is false (5181-5183).
findings.checkpoint_detail: Cancellation does not clear all checkpoint objects or zero the session immediately. It retains previously completed checkpoints that were pruned to valid prefixes at request start (5958-5962); a new checkpoint is created only after an entire prompt segment succeeds (6295-6300). The next request therefore either restores a matching saved prefix (5891-5899,5974-6005) or starts at zero and clears checks (5965-5973). No current generate.cpp path reuses the cancelled partial state as a live prefix.
findings.engine_evidence: The layer-major Restore explicitly restores borrowed C++ fields, not session tensors (candidate src/prefill/layer_major.inc:367-369); the armed lease drains queued work while owners remain alive (398-412). The two-piece path can observe stop between pieces (candidate src/prefill/prefill.cpp:1874-1888) or between expert jobs (candidate src/prefill/moe_window.inc:120-121).
findings.decision: Treat this as a caller invariant and regression gate, not a demonstrated bug in the current generate.cpp server path. Preserve live_ok invalidation and checkpoint gating; require any future Prefill caller to invalidate/restore after a failed partial run.

findings.finding: The candidate cannot run with the ordinary non-compact fallback: run_layer_major rejects unless m.compact_moe_fp16 is true and MMQ is explicitly off (candidate src/prefill/layer_major.inc:95-103). The existing compact option is enabled by STRATA_PREFILL_MOE_COMPACT_FP16=1 and requires a valid fallback layout (primary baseline src/prefill/prefill.cpp:704-718). Therefore the comparable window-off arm must keep the same compact configuration.
findings.correction: R972's two-whole-piece-gathers versus one-gather-per-window-job discussion is a non-eligible counterfactual for this candidate. Its compact-mode counts are the applicable comparison: balanced full coverage is 1024 baseline gathers versus 512 candidate gathers; the concentrated ne==W top-10 case is 20 versus 20. Keep the non-compact case labeled as background only, not as the candidate's default comparison.

findings.finding: The source count of 3090 validations for 512 balanced active experts/jobs is correct: 18 fixed view/backing checks, 3 per expert (blob, dq_gu, dq_d), and 3 per job (mixed, source, Down) in candidate src/prefill/moe_window.inc:17-63,126-142.
findings.correction: Hoisting only the two dequant-scratch checks from 512 experts to one window saves 1022 calls (1024 current calls minus 2 retained). Hoisting mixed-span validation from 512 jobs to one saves 511. Total removable repeats are 1533, not 1536+511=2047. The blob span check is expert-specific and must remain per expert.

findings.finding: For W=16384,K=10, each int32 route plane is 655360 B and D2H IDs plus H2D slot/source maps remains 1966080 B total in both arms. The candidate reduces route-map submissions but not bytes (candidate src/prefill/moe_window.inc:102-115; baseline primary src/prefill/prefill.cpp:2808-2810,2924-2930).
findings.finding_sync: The intermediate GPU-bank pair has four explicit pair-local stream synchronizations in each arm (baseline two route drains plus two stores; candidate two attention-bank drains plus one route drain plus one HC-write drain). On the final callback layer the candidate has six versus baseline four, including two extra attention-bank copy drains (candidate src/prefill/prefill.cpp:3503-3508,3518-3523; candidate src/prefill/moe_window.inc:103-105,149-154; baseline primary src/prefill/layer_major.inc:648-679). This is source call-site counting, not time.
findings.finding_gather_and_dequant: The candidate gathers one job at a time (candidate src/prefill/moe_window.inc:120-146), dequantizes once per expert in the window, and splits jobs at 8192 rows. The logical dequant-output savings are one dequant pair per expert present in both pieces; for the hypothetical all-512 intersection, 512 * 9830400 = 5033164800 B. These do not establish DRAM savings, actual route distribution, or speed.

findings.finding: Candidate IDs and both map planes use std::vector storage (candidate src/prefill/prefill.cpp:439-445; src/prefill/moe_window.inc:102-115; route header owns its map vectors). The ordinary mapped baseline can use cudaHostAllocMapped storage (primary src/prefill/prefill.cpp:534-540,900-910). Lifetime is covered by the checked drain, but source does not prove asynchronous overlap for the pageable candidate vectors. The report correctly treats this as a measurement concern, not a speed or safety conclusion.

accepted_scope_limits: The two-piece path is enabled only with both residual spans in the device prefix; host/mixed placement falls back to the existing 8K route (candidate src/prefill/prefill.cpp:1880-1888).
Its server periodic-prefix-checkpoint consumer is explicitly gated off; candidate generate.cpp:4708 and layer_major.inc:47-52. That gate avoids claiming checkpoint/RESTORE support.

The 998443520 B typed-view reservation and job arithmetic are source accounting only. No physical fit, queue/DMA, codegen/link, tensor/state, numerical-contract, physical-262144, RESTORE or speed qualification follows from these reports or the syntax receipt.
main_next_actions: Before changing buffers or span checks, pin the baseline and run the same eligible configuration with the window switch off/on: native16 BF16, layer-major, STRATA_PREFILL_MOE_COMPACT_FP16=1, explicit STRATA_PREFILL_MMQ=0, same model/cache/session and GPU placement.

Capture per-pair route counts/overlap and actual compact gather, dequant, GEMM job shapes, route copy submissions/bytes, explicit sync call sites, host submit/wait time and device counters. Keep GPU-resident, RAM fallback and final-layer callback results separate; no call-count or logical-byte inference should be reported as speed.

Keep the cancellation regression, but assert that a failed partial Prefill never re-enables live reuse and that the next server request restores a valid earlier checkpoint or resets the session. Do not describe Restore as session rollback.

Only after an as-is trace, consider hoisting two invariant scratch-span checks and the invariant mixed-span check, or changing host map allocation. Measure the final-layer 8K path separately before keeping the extra bank copies and drains.

fresh_research.reason: The remaining questions require Main-owned code changes, actual engine builds/GPU execution, queue and fit checks, and paired measurements. R971/R972 cover the source-audit gap; another source-only scope would repeat known facts before its prerequisites are measured.
